wren: Draft: the bow-string and arrow relationship is ambiguous. Preserve the approved native identity; this illustration is not a locked shooting pose.
tobin: Draft: approved sprite uses a kite shield (the early brief incorrectly said round). Expanded cap embroidery and heraldry are proposals, not approved identity changes.
pip: Supplied Concept 04 reused byte-for-byte. No new Pip design or pose approval is implied. The isolated pose-lock test uses her older approved native sprite, separately.
hesketh: Revise: short lighting rod became nearly full-height flaming staff. Keep the elderly lamp-worker character; simplify equipment and decoration.
bram: Strong brief match: broad working silhouette, exposed forearms, held woodaxe. Concept remains pending owner review.
maren: Long shredded cloak and repeated cross motifs are additional design proposals. Prefer the gravekeeper name-strip identity; do not treat motifs as established lore.
aldric: Revise: banner finial is cropped by top border. Complete equipment silhouette required before master selection.
kestrel: Revise: spear has very little top clearance; cloak is broader and more elaborate than the narrow split-coat brief.
thessaly: Revise: shallow jar is missing, replaced by two lanterns. Retain reeds and marsh palette; restore water-reading equipment distinction.
anselm: Strong brief match: substantial body, attached bell harness and held mallet. No pose approval implied.
grenna: Strong brief match: quarry apron and square maul distinguish her from Bram. Pending owner review.
isolde: Short blade and contract work; long shredded cloak and armour exceed the fitted practical silhouette.
oriel: Large radiant armillary focus is an added proposal replacing the small star fragment. Sky chart remains distinctive.
morwen: Candle rack and garden gear work; orange curls, freckles and clasps resemble Pip. Distinguish face and simplify trim before master approval.
vesper: Lute and songbook read clearly. Broad elaborate coat and many charms exceed the slim travelling-musician brief.
elowen: Revise toward simple pale mantle and modest light: current embroidery and lantern are elaborate. Review facial age/wear.
caedmon: Strong theme match: heavy charred plate, ember seams and held sword. No approval or game integration implied.
corvin: Older face and narrow blade fit; ornate clasps, belts and shredded cloak exceed the restrained court silhouette.
cass: Female presentation matches canonical she/her. Double-ended oversized harpoon, abundant shell charms and longer coat are added proposals.
loveday: Optical case and oilskin fit; lantern needs a distinctive shutter mechanism instead of an ordinary cross-braced lamp.
davy: Strong brief match: adult carrier with attached water yoke and held cudgel. Cans remain attached.
linnet: Revise focus: glass orb currently reads too much like a fire orb. Show recognisable molten-glass material and a practical blowing-pipe tip.
ragna: Review age: grey hair suggests maturity more strongly than the face. Retain botanical mantle and closed kettle distinction.
asta: Older female guide matches canonical lore. Two hanging lanterns replace the compact ember charm; simplify the long decorated cape and equipment.
ferrin: Strong occupational match: soot mask, held pick and strapped brush. Confirm full-figure/tool-detail geometry before an equipment lock.
oswin: Oversized shield, patched olive clothing and short sword distinguish him from Tobin. Face reads very young; brief specifies small adult, so age needs owner review.
hob: Strong occupational match: ice saw, felt cap, work vest and retained hook. Pending owner review.
beatrix: Spectacles, notebook and quill fit. Dense star symbols and ornate layered clothing resemble Oriel; simplify toward practical annotation.
eskil: Bow and cairn charm fit. Cloak is long rather than cropped; verify complete string/nock geometry before a shooting pose lock.
brynja: Strong match: door bar and enclosed brazier. Full bar has forked lower end not shown by upper equipment detail; explicitly retain or simplify before equipment lock.
inga: Auger and calipers distinguish surveying, but large orbital cage repeats Oriel focus. Keep drill and measurement silhouette dominant.
solveig: Visible candle and winter wool fit. Embroidery and numerous charms exceed plain domestic clothing; face reads youthful rather than weathered.
